title: Write an integer in base 2 to 36 with optional zero padding
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It delivers fromBase, which parses a base-N string into a BigInt, the reverse of the toBase function the brief asks for.
It validates every argument with the error types the brief names and pads the uppercase digits of the absolute value before adding the sign.
It pads the signed string, so toBase(-5n, 2, 8) returns "0000-101" instead of "-00000101", while the pasted test output claims that call passed.
A BigInt digit loop writes the magnitude in the requested base, pads it to width and puts the minus sign in front, with each invalid argument throwing the required error.
